• Use the Wicked hood to teleport to the Nature altar exit and run south-west
• Use the Elder divination outfit teleport to the Gleaming wisps colony then run south-west
• Use the Karamja lodestone teleport and run south

4946.d: Camdozaal (referred to as Ramarno's forge on the world map) is a ruined cavern which was once the hall of the Imcando dwarves.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
• Use Lassar Teleport to arrive directly on top of Ice Mountain
• Use a combat bracelet to teleport to Edgeville Monastery then walk south-west to Ice Mountain
• Use a skull sceptre to teleport to Gunnarsgrunn and then walk west to the mountain
• Use the body altar teleport to teleport to the body altar, then walk a short way north-west
• Use Edgeville lodestone teleport and head south-west through the Edgeville Monastery and continue west to Ice Mountain
• Use Falador lodestone teleport and head north-east through the dwarven mine.
